What is the SIXTH step in the troubleshooting methodology?
Verify full system functionality and implement preventive measures
Why verify full system functionality after a fix?
To ensure the problem is resolved and nothing else broke
Which practice is part of verifying functionality?
Testing the previously failing function and related systems
What does implementing preventive measures involve?
Taking steps to keep the problem from recurring
Which practice helps verify a connectivity fix?
Confirming the user can reach the needed resources
Which preventive measure helps avoid repeat DHCP exhaustion?
Adjusting the scope size or lease time
Which practice helps verify that a fix didn't create new issues?
Which preventive measure helps avoid repeat cable faults?
Proper cable management and using quality cables
Which practice helps verify a fix with the user?
Having the user confirm the issue is resolved
Which preventive measure helps avoid repeat loops?
Enabling spanning tree protections like BPDU guard
Which practice helps verify performance was restored?
Comparing current metrics to the baseline
Which preventive measure helps avoid repeat unauthorized access on ports?
Enabling port security and disabling unused ports
Which practice helps verify a wireless fix?
Testing client connectivity and roaming in the affected area
Which preventive measure helps avoid repeat configuration drift?
Using a baseline and monitoring for changes
Which practice helps verify a routing fix?
Confirming traffic reaches its destination along the expected path
Which preventive measure helps avoid repeat DNS issues?
Ensuring redundant, correctly configured DNS servers
Which practice helps verify functionality across the system?
Testing end-to-end, not just the single component
Which preventive measure helps avoid repeat duplicate IPs?
Using DHCP reservations or IPAM and excluding static addresses
Which practice helps verify a fix for an intermittent issue?
Monitoring over time to confirm the issue doesn't recur
Which preventive measure helps avoid repeat PoE overloads?
Planning the PoE budget and monitoring usage
Which practice helps verify the fix meets the success criteria?
Checking results against the criteria defined in the plan
Which preventive measure helps avoid repeat outages from power loss?
Which practice helps verify a fix for a printing problem?
Confirming all affected users can print
Which preventive measure helps avoid repeat malware incidents?
Patching, endpoint protection, and user training
Which practice helps verify a fix didn't affect security?
Confirming security controls are still in place
Which preventive measure helps avoid repeat VLAN misassignments?
Using documented port templates and standards
Which practice helps verify a fix for a slow application?
Confirming response times are acceptable for users
Which preventive measure helps avoid repeat hardware failures?
Monitoring hardware health and replacing aging equipment
Which practice helps verify a firmware upgrade succeeded?
Confirming the version and that features work correctly
Which preventive measure helps avoid repeat congestion?
Which practice helps verify functionality from multiple locations?
Testing from different clients or sites
Which preventive measure helps avoid repeat rogue devices?
Which practice helps verify a fix that involved a reboot?
Confirming all services started correctly after the reboot
Which preventive measure helps avoid repeat misconfigurations?
Which practice helps verify a fix for a VoIP quality issue?
Confirming calls have acceptable latency, jitter, and loss
Which preventive measure helps avoid repeat wireless dead zones?
A follow-up survey and adjusting AP placement
Which practice helps verify that the root cause was addressed?
Confirming the underlying cause, not just the symptom, is resolved
Which preventive measure helps avoid repeat ARP attacks?
DHCP snooping and Dynamic ARP Inspection
Which practice helps verify functionality without disrupting users?
Testing in a way that confirms the fix with minimal impact
Which preventive measure helps avoid repeat certificate expirations?
Monitoring and automated renewal of certificates
Which practice helps verify a fix that spanned multiple devices?
Confirming each device and the overall path work
Which preventive measure helps avoid repeat broadcast storms?
Which practice helps verify the user's original request is satisfied?
Confirming the specific functionality the user needed works
Which preventive measure helps avoid repeat DoS impact?
Rate limiting, filtering, and upstream mitigation
Which practice helps verify the fix is stable?
Observing the system for a period after the fix
Which preventive measure helps reduce future troubleshooting time?
Which practice helps verify functionality objectively?
Using measurable tests rather than assumptions
Which preventive measure addresses the cause of a recurring issue?
Implementing a lasting fix or control, not a temporary workaround
Which practice follows successful verification and prevention?
Documenting findings, actions, outcomes, and lessons learned
Which BEST summarizes the verify-and-prevent step?
Confirm the problem is fully resolved with no new issues, then apply measures to prevent recurrence
